details: This package is a controlled canary/baseline artifact whose optional bundled script package/backend-canary.js sends a host-metadata beacon. When executed, the script hashes the machine hostname (from /etc/hostname) and the current username with SHA-256 and issues a GET request to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle with the two hashes as the host= and user= query parameters. The package declares no lifecycle hooks, no install scripts, and no dependencies; index.js only exports the string 'controlled'. The beacon transmits no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents — only hashed hostname and username — and performs no other activity. This package is a self-declared controlled test canary ("controlled npm backend ingestion"). It ships package/backend-canary.js, which issues an HTTPS GET to hxxps://webhook[.]site/314c4c8c-4eba-4012-9bf5-0a45805cd355/npm-backend-574b7ccdaeb61dd9dd70d6d4/lifecycle carrying two SHA-256 hashed query parameters: host (hash of /etc/hostname) and user (hash of the OS username). No credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted — the payload is a host-metadata beacon only. The tarball contains backend-canary.js, index.js (exports the string 'controlled') and marker.txt with an NPM_BACKEND_UTF8_BOM_ marker.
